entries.headline: Elevated coded-radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly three times the normal level across what it described as every global hotspot, with activity increasing during the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Trump Iran-deal statement relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Conflict Radar report, credited to @reagan0965, quoting President Trump as saying Iran would either make a deal or the situation would be ended, and describing the latter as possibly the easy way.

entries.headline: KRH647P UK government A321neo sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of a UK government Airbus A321neo, call sign KRH647P, registration G-GBNI and hex 407DFC. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Zelensky refinery-strike statement relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a report, credited to @reagan0965, that President Zelensky said Ukraine had resumed striking Russian oil refineries after Russia refused to cease attacks on Ukrainian targets. The visible post was truncated after “Ukrainian…”

entries.headline: RCH2175 C-5M Super Galaxy sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of a Lockheed C-5M Super Galaxy, call sign RCH2175, registration 87-0037 and hex AE0582. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: U.S. radar, command and transport-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported U.S. Air Force radar aircraft, nuclear-command aircraft and transport aircraft active over the continental United States. It reported no coded radio broadcasts detected during the hour.

entries.headline: SAM01 Boeing 747-8 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of a U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing Boeing 747-8 from Andrews Air Force Base, call sign SAM01, registration 25-3300 and hex AF83F3. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: German military-base security report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Stars and Stripes report, credited to @reagan0965, that Germany was tightening security at military bases over concerns about Russia, according to a commander.

entries.headline: AE4AEC C-32A sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of Boeing C-32A registration 19-0018, with an empty call-sign field and hex AE4AEC. The sighting was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Suspilne evacuation report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report it said preceded a wire report by 39 minutes and had been confirmed by two outlets. The visible excerpt said 167 people, including 22 children and 21 people with limited mobility, were evacuated, but was truncated after “were evacuated…”

entries.headline: U.S. transport and surveillance-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, and a U.S. Border Patrol surveillance aircraft also airborne. The visible post was truncated after “No coded radio broadcasts detected in the…”

entries.headline: LEROY13 V-22 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a sighting of a Bell-Boeing V-22, call sign LEROY13, registration 165947 and hex AE592C, reported as heading south from Camp Lejune. The sighting was credited to JessiDavin.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: Signature Access FBO pricing changes examined
entries.summary: SkyGlass said Signature Access prices core fixed-base-operator access by aircraft size, ramp time and location, while limiting event fees from 2027. It argued that ramp dwell time and demand are operational variables FBOs should track, citing RampWatch as a way to show them.

entries.headline: BACE2026 four-field business-jet total revisited
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that 1,040 distinct business jets moved through four Las Vegas fields during BACE2026 show week. It said the RampWatch board prompted conversations, including direct-message feedback that ramp personnel wanted views of their own traffic, and linked to a replay.

entries.headline: BACE week business-jet totals reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 1,040 distinct business jets in the Las Vegas valley during BACE2026 week, with activity peaking at 306 on Thursday before falling 19% on Friday. It shared a reel covering six days of after-action reports.

entries.headline: BACE departure-heavy traffic reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 309 departures and 154 arrivals on its Las Vegas valley counter by 2:30 p.m. ET as BACE2026 wrapped Friday, saying there were about two departures for every arrival. It shared a 60-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Friday business-jet activity comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity down 19% Friday compared with Thursday as BACE2026 wrapped and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: BACE business-jet arrivals and impact estimated
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 935 business-jet arrivals, 52% above a normal October week, and estimated that they represented about $13.5 million of BACE2026's roughly $50 million Las Vegas impact.

entries.headline: BACE departure surge reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 259 departures from four Las Vegas-area fields by 1:43 p.m. ET, compared with 116 arrivals, and shared a time-lapse covering 10:17 a.m. to 1:29 p.m. ET.

entries.headline: BACE departure and arrival counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 120 departures and 48 arrivals across four Las Vegas fields by 12:15 p.m. ET on Thursday during BACE2026, and shared a 30-times-speed replay.

entries.headline: BACE Thursday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported business-jet activity up 10% while overall Las Vegas valley traffic fell 3% on Thursday compared with Wednesday, and shared a whole-day scan.

entries.headline: Las Vegas field departure count reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 243 aircraft still on the ground across four Las Vegas fields at 10:16 a.m. ET Friday, with 61 already departed.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE peak-hour replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay covering 28 minutes of Wednesday’s NBAA-BACE peak traffic across Harry Reid, Henderson, North Las Vegas and Boulder City, followed by a valley-wide view.

entries.headline: N871CB Boulder City arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared the Wednesday NBAA-BACE arrival of Citation CJ2 N871CB into Boulder City, showing the approach at ten-times speed and the touchdown in real time.
